column1: # Engine perf suite rows, the lowest median of each in microseconds, checked
# linux --perf). One row<TAB>microseconds record per line; a row is named
# <section> | <label> as the suite prints them, whitespace collapsed. A row
# fails when it is more than 10% and more than 5 us over its value here, and an
# unlisted row fails. Wall times only compare on the machine named by #host;
# anywhere else the leg is a SKIP, and CI never runs it.
# Lower values after a fix with: bash scripts/regress/perf-ratchet.sh --update
# It only lowers values and drops rows the suite no longer runs. Raising a
# value or adding a row is a hand edit, and the change has to say why.
# Recorded with 0.16.1 (07571ad8), the lowest of six runs, for the rows it has.
# The Multicore with one or two busy strips rows are newer than 0.16.1 and
# carry the 0.17 candidate's values (507f9013 plus the JSON rows), also the
